svg.title: Little's law
svg.desc: Ride requests arrive at a pricing server at 500 a second, and each holds a database connection for 20 ms, so about 10 of the 16 pooled connections are busy at any moment. Then a query slows to 200 ms. Traffic stays the same, but every connection fills up, requests line up waiting, and the formula shows 100 connections are now needed.
svg.text: Same traffic, slower query. 500 × 0.2 s needs 100 connections, not 10.
